steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Oh, sorry, Doctor. I was spacing out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, um, there's a matter of some concern.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, look, it's an internal transfer application.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The applicant is Natalya Rostova.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She wants to transfer from Logistics to the front line.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. She's the only member working in Logistics.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand they appreciate her talent and efficiency.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course you'd be worried about it too. Honestly, I don't really want to approve this one.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get it. Ursus names are hard. I'm not surprised you forgot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's one of the survivors we rescued from Chernobog, and a member of Zima's Ursus Student Self-government Group.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In fact, she was the only aristocrat among the refugees.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you remember that Zima's team became combat operators at their own request?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I was actually against it at first.

options: It hasn't been that long since they were rescued...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. Originally, even though they requested it themselves, I was going to convince Dr. Kal'tsit to veto the application.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They get regular psychological counseling and according to the reports, they're generally healthy, notwithstanding the occasional dark spot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know how to put it better.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor, can you go check on Miss Rostova?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know it's kind of a pain, but you're the only one who can do it, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, this is really important. Don't be lazy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And you really don't have to take it too seriously. Just think of it as a little change of scenery.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, it's already lunchtime. No need to rush, you can go see her after you eat.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, Doctor.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Nothing. Just saying hey, since I saw you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, don't pretend you didn't hear me. I saw you stop.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Aren't you like super busy all the time? What are you doing wandering the halls?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You don't look busy.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I've got a mission. I can't be enjoying a leisurely stroll like you.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I told you not to wander before deployments, Zima.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Afternoon, Doctor.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Come on, Zima, back to the ready room. It's time to go.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. One day I'm gonna be the captain and boss you around.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You too, Doctor. You're gonna answer to me.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I like the ambition. Let's talk about it after you've got one on me.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: As for the Doctor, well, you'll have to have won a lot more than one.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Eh.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Oh, Doctor, you should know, I've been taking the rookie team lately.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: So if you don't have anything else, I'll get going.

options: What do you think of Zima?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hm... Well, you just saw that she doesn't take well to discipline. She's very insubordinate.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: And as a warrior, at her age, it's normal to not know what you're fighting, or what you're fighting for.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But it's especially obvious for Zima.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: She suffers from a lot of confusion. I don't know exactly what it is, but it's a bad sign and something I'm going to focus on correcting next.

options: You mean she only looks tough?
*Sigh*, I'd really like to get along with her.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Right. Violence is a protective shell for her.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I wouldn't go so far as to say she has a fragile heart under that shell, but I can say that toughness is very fragile, in front of me.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Don't worry, Doctor. She's still a kid.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I heard she's from Chernobog. I'm sure she's carrying a lot of baggage. But she has a future.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hah, don't worry, Doctor.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You must know, she doesn't hate you or anything.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: In fact, she seems to reflexively attack people close to her.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But I do have to say, I think this kid's all right, Doctor.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: In fact, I like her. She's got a strong sense of integrity. So even if she's confused, that integrity will keep her on the right path.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: And that's rare.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Okay, I gotta get going. Please excuse me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Wow, it's the Doctor!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Afternoon, Doctor!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Am I too short?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hellooo, Doctor, do you see me?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're looking good today!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Are you here to eat?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I haven't had any missions lately, so I'm helping out in the kitchen.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Gummy, I brought the spices.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, thanks, Perfumer! Just put them over there.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Did you want something to eat?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: No thank you. I'm used to cooking for myself in my workshop.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oooh, can I come eat with you sometime? I really wanna learn to use spices like you do!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Heh heh. But of course.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Gummy, can you lend a hand when you've got a minute?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hung is out on a mission and I'm a little short-handed. I need you to take this pot for me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Sure, Uncle Matterhorn! I'll see you next time, Perfumer. And you eat well too, Doctor!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Sure. You're welcome anytime.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Is Gummy cooking today?!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Oh man, what luck!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Too bad I just ate!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator
steps.text: Haha, I'll get seconds!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Settle down, everybody. There's enough to go around!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Gummy sure has a lot of energy, doesn't she, Doctor?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: One time, when she fell asleep in my workshop, I heard her talking in her sleep. What she said worried me a bit.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But when I see her like this, adapting so well to life at Rhodes Island, I feel like I have nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You can't expect them to heal instantly. But given time, they'll be okay.

options: What did she say in her sleep?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Oh, Doctor, some things call for discretion, you know?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I'll be keeping that secret for her. But rest assured, she doesn't need comfort, she just needs time.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You care, Doctor? Heh heh. You really worry about your operators.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But rest assured, if there was something really important, I wouldn't hold my tongue.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: A girl has her secrets, you know?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Doctor, don't be so full of yourself that you think you have to take care of everyone.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: We can look after each other too.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: It's time I went back to the office.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: If you ever find yourself tired, Doctor, you can always come sit with me.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hello, Doctor.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I've never seen you in the canteen before, Doctor.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You look like you have something on your mind, Doctor. I suggest you find a better place to stand and think than the cafeteria doorway.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm... the rice is a little firm today, and the soup is too sweet. But I'm enjoying the vegetables.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If there's nothing more, Doctor, I'll be going.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I have class in the afternoon.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, Hypatia's history class.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: After auditing for a while, I found Hypatia's take on history very helpful for me.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm. No.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean to refuse you. I'm having trouble explaining, because I'm not very clear either.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hypatia's lectures are very interesting. I think you should take a listen yourself, when you have time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Um, Doctor, did I not hear that you suffer from amnesia?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But I appreciate the offer.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'll say, I could use some guidance.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: In fact, I'm not certain the study of history will help me that much.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: However, thinking on the experiences of our forebears could provide me some inspiration.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm off to class then.

options: Do you know where Natalya is?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya...? You're looking for her?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy told me she wants to become a front line operator. I haven't heard if her application has been approved, but from what I know of her, she is likely already preparing for the transfer.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Your aim sucks, Natalya.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Don't be so sure, Rosalind. I'm going to hit you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hehe, no way in hell~

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And you gotta call me Leto now! Operator Rosa~

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Okay, Operator Leto. Let us wait and see.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And who got you using such a big sucker?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You found it in Chernobog, right? Why not throw it away and get something new?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Hup... sentimental value.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Okay. More work for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It kinda looks like you can't move anymore. Why not take a little break?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: I can still...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You lack stamina, Natalya.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Being Ursus gives you a nice base to build on, but you're a long way from combat ready.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Pshh... whew... Sorry. I'll keep trying.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But your willpower is a lot stronger than I thought. Not bad.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If you can push through this round of training, it'll be good for you, even if you don't become an operator.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Thanks for that.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hm... hm?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Take five.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Leto, you get out there and train yourself.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yes, sir~

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Grace, keep an eye on her.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor, it's lunchtime. You should be resting. We don't need you here.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Afternoon, Doctor.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If you're just here to say hello to me, I've got plenty to get back to.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You're slowly but surely becoming a leader. That's no bad thing, I have to say.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You can, but I have to take time to deal with you. I hope it won't be a lot.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But I guess Amiya told you we have another girl from Zima's group who wants to be an operator, and you wanted to check her out?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Don't look so surprised.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Everyone knows Amiya is very concerned about the survivors we rescued from Ursus.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You must remember Zima, Gummy, Istina, Leto——

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Well, Leto is an exception. Nothing to worry about in the combat department.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: When those four girls applied, Amiya was dead-set against it. She wanted to veto their applications. I don't know why, but she changed her mind at some point in the process.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: And so now that there's another one, it would be out of character for her not to care...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Phew, that's enough rest. Rosalind, practice with me a while.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wow, you're really committed.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Don't underestimate my determination to become an operator.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright alright.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Natalya, you still need to rest. The most important part of exercise is recovery. If you keep grinding away at it, you're just going to break your body.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Thank you, Instructor Grace, but I think I still have some strength left in me...

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Hey, don't worry about Dobermann, I know she looks scary...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Grace, I can hear you.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Oh, well, you get it.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Yes, but don't worry.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What do you think of her?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Is she now? I don't think so.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I've seen her type. They grit their teeth, fighting hard not to think.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doesn't it remind you of those three?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They don't know where courage comes from, so they bite down and take on society, no matter their age.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But they do seem to be ready.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Yes she is. Honestly, she exceeds my expectations.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: An aristocratic young lady who can actually work hard for herself... hah.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I do understand Amiya's instinct to keep them off the battlefield.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor, no one would be happy to send young people to war. Isn't the point of a soldier like me to protect kids like that?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I always blame myself for them having to go fight.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But I've come to terms with the fact that I can't save everyone.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All I can do is teach them to fight, to protect themselves, and to get home in one piece.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Think about it, Doctor, what can you do for them?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Welcome back, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So what do you think?

options: Did you see something in Zima and her girls, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Yes. That's why I've been paying more attention to them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, Doctor, I... wasn't sure if I should tell anyone about this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You know about my ability to sense a person's most powerful emotions, and to even feel them when they're directed at me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If they're not directed at me, but still strong enough, I can't feel them as clearly, but I can still sense something.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And the Ursus girls... it's hard to say.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Their situation is different.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At times, times that would seem ordinary to us, I will sense immense, overpowering emotion from them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course, their emotions are different, but they share some commonalities.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If I had to put a name to the main emotion, I think I'd have to say 'helplessness.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They are not so sad, not pained, not angry, not hopeless...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe it's not the right word. It's like... like there's an invisible wall.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's usually invisible and intangible, but it blocks them whenever they try to move forward. And they're stuck.

options: Is there anything we can do for them?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are in no position to help them now, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What each operator is willing to tell us when they register their file, that's all we 'can' know about them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They may be hiding something from us. But if so, we have even less reason to dig it up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course, that doesn't include things that might adversely affect Rhodes Island. But I don't think Zima's group falls into that category.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not sure us suddenly reaching out to help them would actually be helpful.

options: Unprompted help is a selfish act.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, I think so too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe it's just that I'm a little afraid to do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Doctor, you're teasing again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If only it were that simple.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I feel like 'I understand you' isn't worth much.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But people love to say it. As if it fulfills their duty to provide comfort, or that it will make someone open up to them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's hard to understand someone's feelings, let alone help them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Many operators on board this vessel are the same, actually.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't share any particular experience with them, our words don't get through to them, and what we do, even if it's right, won't be what they want.

options: So you didn't stop the Ursus girls from becoming operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After sensing their emotions, I changed my mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Forcing them to safety may seem to us like the right move, like it's best for them. And it probably would keep them safe, in practice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But that would not help them heal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I really don't want to say that time heals all wounds.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I don't know any other way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All I can do is respect their choice, and protect them in my own, Rhodes Island way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When I think about it like that, I feel kind of full of myself...

options: Rhodes Island isn't a greenhouse. You're on the right track.
Then just make friends with everyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, but I always hope I can do more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, how to or whether to treat someone, from a physical perspective, is rarely something that needs consideration.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But when it comes to mental health, it becomes a more difficult problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For now, I can give only a vague answer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, you're right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we aren't in a position to help someone, we must create the position.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm just a little frustrated.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Medicine is for pain, to heal wounds. And some medicines can heal. But in any case, they can't erase the pain and suffering endured before the medicine is applied.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've always wondered if Rhodes Island could help some people, even if only a few, to forget, or at least let go of the trauma they've suffered in the past.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've realized along the way that it's really hard.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Developing the drug is only the most basic first step. There's so much more we would have to do to be able to achieve this.

options: At least we're already doing it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah. At least we are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm kind of embarrassed that you're comforting and encouraging me over someone else's business...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Anyway, to business, I'm approving Miss Rostova's application.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope that one day she and her friends are willing to open up to us. I hope that one day, we are able to help them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope that one day... Rhodes Island can become their now home.
